proof_body:
by
  intro G _ hnil N hN hne hbot
  have key : ∀ n, ∀ x ∈ N, x ∈ Subgroup.upperCentralSeries G n → x = 1 := by
    intro n
    induction n with
    | zero =>
      intro x _ hx
      rw [Subgroup.upperCentralSeries_zero] at hx
      exact hx
    | succ n ih =>
      intro x hxN hx
      have hc : x ∈ Subgroup.center G := by
        rw [Subgroup.mem_center_iff]
        intro y
        have h1 : x * y * x⁻¹ * y⁻¹ ∈ Subgroup.upperCentralSeries G n := Subgroup.mem_upperCentralSeries_succ_iff.1 hx y
        have h2 : x * y * x⁻¹ * y⁻¹ ∈ N := by
          have h3 := hN.conj_mem x⁻¹ (N.inv_mem hxN) y
          have h4 := N.mul_mem hxN h3
          have h5 : x * (y * x⁻¹ * y⁻¹) = x * y * x⁻¹ * y⁻¹ := by group
          rwa [h5] at h4
        have h6 := ih _ h2 h1
        have h7 : x * y = y * x := by
          calc x * y = (x * y * x⁻¹ * y⁻¹) * (y * x) := by group
            _ = y * x := by rw [h6, one_mul]
        exact h7.symm
      have : x ∈ N ⊓ Subgroup.center G := ⟨hxN, hc⟩
      rw [hbot] at this
      exact this
  obtain ⟨n, hn⟩ := hnil.nilpotent
  apply hne
  rw [eq_bot_iff]
  intro x hx
  exact key n x hx (by rw [hn]; trivial)
target_source: ∀ (G : Type*) [Group G] [Group.IsNilpotent G] (N : Subgroup G), N.Normal → N ≠ ⊥ → N ⊓ Subgroup.center G ≠ ⊥
